name: Ja beremenna v 16
source:
A visual novel about tough choices and their consequences.
This story will guide you through the heroine's experiences, her search for meaning, and her attempts to find her place in the world. Complex relationships with family, friends, and her first boyfriend force her to make important decisions that will shape her future.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部关于艰难选择及其后果的视觉小说。
这个故事将引导你了解女主人公的经历、她对意义的探索以及她在世界上找到自己位置的尝试。与家人、朋友和第一任男友的复杂关系迫使她做出影响她未来的重要决定。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3464570/]Steam[/url]]
